effect_description_eng: [On Play] [When Digivolving] 1 of your Digimon gets +3000 DP for the turn. Then, if this Digimon's stack has 2 or more same-level cards, this Digimon gains ＜Raid＞ (When this Digimon attacks, you may switch the target of attack to 1 of your opponent's unsuspended Digimon with the highest DP.) and ＜Piercing＞ for the turn. (When this Digimon attacks and deletes an opponent's Digimon and survives the battle, it performs any security checks it normally would.)
